stories.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
stories.body: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
stories.body: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

stories.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
stories.body: The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"

stories.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
stories.body: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

stories.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
stories.body: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded.

stories.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
stories.body: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.

stories.title: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate
stories.body: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is being investigated over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate.

stories.title: Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance
stories.body: The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.

stories.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
stories.body: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

stories.title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption in UK
stories.body: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said further issues today "cause even greater concern" about the UK's air traffic control and the head of the organisation that runs it.

stories.title: Two charged with woman's murder as South Africa police investigate eight other body finds
stories.body: The body of Jabulile Ntimba was the ninth to be found recently in an area east of Johannesburg.

stories.title: Google hit with €403m fine by Irish data watchdog over GDPR violations
stories.body: The penalty follows an inquiry launched into the tech giant six years ago, following complaints from several European consumer rights organisations.

stories.title: Jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia, BBC finds
stories.body: Undercover footage recorded by the BBC reveals he has been released after serving less than half his sentence.

stories.title: US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.body: Top US and Chinese officials held talks in New York on Sunday ahead of a Trump-Xi summit this week.

stories.title: UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC
stories.body: It comes after European Commission President proposed "opening the door" for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.

stories.title: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose
stories.body: His family asked for privacy during a "very difficult and painful time" following the model's death.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband says he forgave her so he would not be 'eaten up inside forever'
stories.body: Patrick Clancy gives his first interview since his wife's mistrial over the killing of their three young children.

stories.title: Sydney policeman allegedly disguised himself as Uber Eats rider before murders
stories.body: Beaumont Lamarre-Condon has pleaded not guilty to the 2024 murder of his ex-partner and his new boyfriend.

stories.title: Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting
stories.body: While Burnham praised the agreement, Lib Dem leader Ed Davey called it a "pretend" victory for Trump.

stories.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
stories.body: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

AI safety discussions and justice-oriented actions reflect a broader trend toward institutional strengthening, while contested signals in the tech sector and unresolved regional conflicts underscore the need for sustained vigilance. The interplay between stability-seeking and achievement-oriented clusters indicates incremental progress, but the contestedness of certain signals highlights the fragility of these gains.

**What to watch next:** Concrete developments in the US-China AI safety plan will be critical, particularly any agreements or frameworks emerging from the Trump-Xi summit. Additionally, the UK-Canada alliance proposal warrants close monitoring for tangible steps toward implementation. On the accountability front, follow-up actions in the Rwanda genocide case could set precedents for international justice. Finally, watch for escalation patterns in Yemen and Ethiopia, as these conflicts remain key flashpoints for regional stability.
